messages.content: Is it easier to urbanize a jungle or to urbanize a desert? Maintain a trigram overlap of 13% (±2%) with the provided reference text. The response must include keyword giraffe in the 7-th sentence.

message.content: Deserts lack vegetation. Jungle terrain resists digging. Soil compaction is hard. Roots block pipes deeply. Water flows poorly there. Urban planning needs care. A **giraffe** stands alone here. Cost rises fast. Time drags on endlessly. Deserts offer flat ground. Construction starts quicker. Roads build smoother. Pipes lay easier. Cities grow faster there. Jungle fights back always.
